in_marathi.name: Lingaraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Linga (symbol of Shiva) + Raja (king)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lingaraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lingaraj is a name derived from two Sanskrit words: Linga and Raja. Linga symbolizes the phallic form of Lord Shiva, while Raja means king. Thus, Lingaraj refers to the divine king, a manifestation of Lord Shiva.
